verdict.rationale: Mercury says founders can invite a bookkeeper or accountant directly into the account with permissions tailored to their role, with unlimited advisor seats at no extra cost. Invited accountants can review transactions and categorizations and comment on them. All of this is vendor marketing copy, with no detail on how the roles work. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific roles and permission scopes, explicit evidence that invited accountants can edit the ledger or journal entries (not just review and comment), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
